en: Allow me to explain the basics of{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}communicating with other worlds{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}There are countless other worlds{SAUT}that exist parallel to this one...{PAGE}And indeed, countless parallel versions{SAUT}of yourself. Even now, they seek to{SAUT}contact you from their own worlds.{PAGE}If you wish to communicate with these{SAUT}other versions of you, you will need{SAUT}the {f 0 1 2}P-Book{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}Your team's information and one{SAUT}Sub-Persona can be included within the{SAUT}P-Book.{PAGE}When you exchange a Book with another{SAUT}you,{f 0 1 2} you'll both be able to summon the{SAUT}Sub-Personas within the Books{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}Using this ability will give you the{SAUT}opportunity to obtain powerful{SAUT}Sub-Personas.{PAGE}Now then, you must decide on a{SAUT}name to differentiate yourself from{SAUT}the other you.{PAGE}It will be a name for the P-Book...{SAUT}So this shall be known as your {f 0 1 2}P-Book name{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}You can easily change this later,{SAUT}so set it as whatever you please.
